name: Apache SkyWalking
description: Application performance monitoring platform providing distributed tracing, metrics, and service topology analysis.

envVars.description: Address of the SkyWalking OAP backend

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      SW_OAP_ADDRESS: "http://{{serviceName}}-oap:12800"
  {{serviceName}}-oap:
    image: apache/skywalking-oap-server:9.7.0
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-oap
    restart: unless-stopped
